subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: (a) ⎯⎯ flood is considered to be a natural calamity, it is no doubt, a blessing for the people. It is considered to be a blessing in the sense (b) ⎯⎯ it makes the soil alluvial, (c) ⎯⎯ silt is scattered over land after land (d) ⎯⎯ flood and makes the soil fertile. So it can be said that flood has (e) ⎯⎯ constructive and destructive sides.
